'''Docking Bay 117''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] that was located on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Bazarre]], in the [[Mosu system]]. The bay was oval-shapped and included a small office and a set of [[Fusion generator/Legends|fusion generators]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] [[Prit Kessek]] landed her [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ''[[Skinchanger]]'' to Docking Bay 117, to collect a shipment of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] that she had been hired to take to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]] on the behalf of the shipping magnate [[Brevis Taug]]. However, Kessek and her second-in-command [[Kloofus]] were attacked in the bay by a group of agents who were investigating the transfer of Taug's funds. The agents seized control of the ''Skinchanger'' and subsequently departed from Bazarre in it.
